46|PLUGIN_SCHEMA_V1 = "https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json"
47|MCP_SCHEMA_V1 = "https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json"
48|
49|_PLUGIN_FIELDS = {"$schema", "name", "version", "description", "author", "homepage", "repository",
50|                  "license", "keywords", "extensions"}
51|_AUTHOR_FIELDS = {"name", "email", "url"}
52|_STDIO_FIELDS = {"type", "command", "args", "env", "cwd"}
53|_REMOTE_FIELDS = {"type", "url", "headers"}
54|_PLUGIN_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^(?!.*(?:--|\.\.))[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?$")
55|_SKILL_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^(?!.*--)[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$")
56|_PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r"\$\{(PLUGIN_ROOT|PLUGIN_DATA)\}")
57|_HEADER_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[!#$%&'*+\-.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z]+$")

212|def _all_str(values) -> bool:
213|    return all(isinstance(v, str) for v in values)
214|
215|
216|def _str_map(value: object) -> bool:
217|    return isinstance(value, dict) and _all_str(value) and _all_str(value.values())
...
230|def _validate_manifest(root: Path) -> tuple[dict, list[AgentPluginDiagnostic]]:
231|    manifest_path = root / "plugin.json"
232|    if not _inside(manifest_path, root) or not manifest_path.is_file():
233|        raise AgentPluginError("plugin.json must be a regular file within the plugin root")
234|    manifest = _read_json_object(manifest_path, label="plugin.json")
235|    diagnostics: list[AgentPluginDiagnostic] = []
236|    for field in sorted(set(manifest) - _PLUGIN_FIELDS):
237|        diagnostics.append(AgentPluginDiagnostic("manifest", f"ignored unknown top-level field: {field}"))
238|        manifest.pop(field)
239|    if manifest.get("$schema") != PLUGIN_SCHEMA_V1:
240|        raise AgentPluginError("plugin.json declares an unsupported or missing Agent Plugins schema")
241|    name = manifest.get("name")
242|    if not isinstance(name, str) or not 1 <= len(name) <= 64 or _PLUGIN_NAME_RE.fullmatch(name) is None:
243|        raise AgentPluginError("plugin.json name does not satisfy v1 constraints")
244|    for field in ("version", "description", "homepage", "repository", "license"):
245|        if field in manifest and not isinstance(manifest[field], str):
246|            raise AgentPluginError(f"plugin.json {field} must be a string")
247|    keywords = manifest.get("keywords", [])
248|    if not isinstance(keywords, list) or not _all_str(keywords):
249|        raise AgentPluginError("plugin.json keywords must be an array of strings")
250|    author = manifest.get("author", {})
251|    if not isinstance(author, dict):
252|        raise AgentPluginError("plugin.json author must be an object")
253|    if set(author) - _AUTHOR_FIELDS or not _all_str(author.values()):
254|        raise AgentPluginError("plugin.json author may contain only string name, email, and url fields")
255|    extensions = manifest.get("extensions", {})
256|    if not isinstance(extensions, dict):
257|        diagnostics.append(AgentPluginDiagnostic("manifest", "ignored non-object extensions field"))
258|        manifest.pop("extensions")
259|    elif any(not isinstance(value, dict) for value in extensions.values()):
260|        raise AgentPluginError("plugin.json extension namespace values must be objects")
261|    return manifest, diagnostics
